extra.message: Attacker-controlled searchText from the POST /search body or GET /api/search query is concatenated directly into a SQLite query passed to db.all(). An attacker can inject UNION SQL and read arbitrary database data, including user credentials.
Attacker-controlled searchText is rendered using Pug's unescaped != operator. Submitting HTML or script content to POST /search causes it to execute in the response page.

The error template exposes error.stack to clients. app.js assigns the complete error object in development mode, and the provided startup and Docker configurations do not set NODE_ENV=production, so requests to nonexistent routes disclose internal stack traces and filesystem paths by default.

cwe: CWE-209: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information
